mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the aggregate improvement in the quality of life of the population."
Social progress is the aggregate improvement in the quality of life of the population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a consistent whole and appear in clusters."
The features of modernity are a consistent whole and appear in clusters.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a set of ideas that help us in explaining the basic nature of the world and ourselves, and the set of goals relevant to us."
Worldviews are a set of ideas that help us in explaining the basic nature of the world and ourselves, and the set of goals relevant to us.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to measure the standard of living."
The Gross National Income per capita is used to measure the standard of living.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a leading campaigner of the people-centered approach."
The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is a leading campaigner of the people-centered approach.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the end goal of the three other imperatives."
The fourth imperative is the end goal of the three other imperatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the pinnacle of cultural awareness and evolution."
Civilization is the pinnacle of cultural awareness and evolution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means anything new, recent, or latest in whatever sphere it occurs."
Modern means anything new, recent, or latest in whatever sphere it occurs.
fib: ______ is the thing that we have inherited which forms our identity as members of society.
Culture
Culture is the thing that we have inherited which forms our identity as members of society.
______ is the active involvement of people in the development process.
Participatory development
Participatory development is the active involvement of people in the development process.
______ is the view that cultures evolve from simple to more sophisticated, higher forms.
Cultural evolution
Cultural evolution is the view that cultures evolve from simple to more sophisticated, higher forms.
______ is an objective process that features effective interaction and cooperation between beneficiaries of the development project and development agents who execute the initiative.
Authentic participation
Authentic participation is an objective process that features effective interaction and cooperation between beneficiaries of the development project and development agents who execute the initiative.
______ is the traditional outcome metric of developmental economics.
GDP - Gross Domestic Product
GDP - Gross Domestic Product - is the traditional outcome metric of developmental economics.
______ are concerned about whether GDP is a flawed metric for assessing global development.
Philosophers
Philosophers are concerned about whether GDP is a flawed metric for assessing global development.

Gran's view suggests that development is a collective process that allows, or ought to allow, the meaningful and effective participation of all classes of people in the society for the liberation of human potentials.
______ is a fundamental element of the sustainable development framework.
Integrated decision making
Integrated decision making is a fundamental element of the sustainable development framework.
